name: The rush, together
prompt: Eleven tickets on the rail. {name} is on the grill beside you with as many of {their} own.

choices.text: Take some of {name}'s tickets as well as yours

outcome.told: You take three of {their} tickets. Yours run late, and {name} sees why.
You get through yours. Nothing comes back.

failure.told: Two of yours go out cold.

outcome.told: {name} takes the eggs without a word. The rail clears by half past.

failure.told: {name} shakes {their} head. There's no room on {their} side either.
